figure_data.pr_curves: Full curves are rendered directly from the frozen prediction files; per-row values remain local.

method.grouped_shap: Signed within-row sums of the existing 39 analytic feature contributions, then mean absolute group contribution.
method.waterfalls: Five largest absolute feature contributions plus the signed sum of all remaining features.
method.subgroup_selection: One overall annual Top 10% allocation, not a separate top decile within each group.
method.days_earlier: Retrospective fixed-window reference using original-day scores; time-invariant outcomes and earlier feature availability are not established.
method.no_inspector_features: No sanitarian identifiers or clusters are inputs. Label and proxy bias may remain.
method.rounding: Numeric values retain at most four decimal places; display contains the authoritative slide text.
